The file names him with the ordinal, «Saint Arsenije I Sremac», which is this folder's own stored Russian form «Арсений I Сербский» — the I is what separates him from every other Arsenije — and he is the archbishop kept 28 October in the Greek, Russian and Serbian calendars. NOT Arsenius the Great of the Desert, whose own file sits in the same category as «Arsenius der Grosse1.jpg» and is not taken. 800x1284, single figure.
